sharedPrompt.format: One full-bleed illustration that fills the whole image edge to edge. Flat 2D illustration, no 3D rendering, no photorealism.
sharedPrompt.artStyle: Funny, grimy horror cartoon in the manner of a hand-painted 1950s monster-movie poster crossed with a greasy diner menu: bold black ink outlines, flat poster colours, halftone dot shading and dramatic low camera angles with harsh under-lighting. Living, monstrous food with big expressive eyes, too many teeth and comic menace, looming over kitchens and diners. Palette: slime green, ketchup red, mustard yellow, greasy black, dented steel grey and old-menu cream. Drips of sauce, steam and crumbs everywhere. Subtle worn paper grain like an old printed poster. Overall mood: gleefully creepy and silly, never truly disgusting.
frame: Border: a thick border styled like a dented stainless-steel diner counter with a black-and-cream checkerboard trim, chrome rivets and a few cartoon drips of mustard and ketchup running down it.
Top-left corner: a small round set emblem shaped like a silver restaurant cloche with two glowing eyes peering out from under it, with no letters.
Top: an empty name banner shaped like a long chrome diner sign with rounded ends, in pale cream inside a steel edge, about 10% of the card height, with no letters in it.

Bottom: a text panel below the window, about 30% of the card height, in pale cream like a stained paper order ticket, with a thin greasy-black edge. The top third of the panel is empty space for two lines of text. A thin black divider line runs across the panel below that space.

Stats grid: the lower two-thirds of the panel is split into six equal cells, in two rows of three, by thin black dividers. The first cell, top left, has a pale mustard-yellow background to show it is the main stat; the other five stay pale cream. Each cell has one small bold icon on its left side, no wider than a quarter of the cell, and the right three-quarters of the cell is empty space for a word like 'COOK SPEED' and a large number. The icons, top row left to right: a red chilli pepper; a meat cleaver; a green herb sprig. Bottom row left to right: a stopwatch; a wide-open mouth with sharp teeth; a plate with a fork. The icons are simple, flat and bold, in ketchup red, slime green, mustard yellow, steel grey and black.

Card number and rarity: below the panel, on the border, two separate empty badges of the same height. In the bottom-left corner, a wide greasy-black plaque with a steel edge for the card number, about 22% of the card width, so it can hold text like '#50 of 50'. In the bottom-right corner, a wide pill-shaped pale cream badge for the rarity, about 25% of the card width, so it can hold a word of nine capital letters. Both are empty, with no letters.
Accent colours on the frame are only ketchup red, mustard yellow, slime green, steel grey, black and cream. Do not use pink, magenta or hot pink anywhere on the frame.
sharedPrompt.negative: No photorealism, no 3D render, no anime style, no gore, no blood, no real people, no real food brands or restaurant logos, no modern vector/flat-design look, no watermarks, no extra text, no blurry or cut-off borders, no real or existing cartoon characters.

rulesCard.title: How to Play
steps: Two players. Deal all the cards evenly.
Each player shuffles their cards into a deck and places it face down.
Each player takes the top card from their deck and looks at it.
The winner of the last round picks the stat to compare. In the first round, the player who most recently ate the most horrible food picks.
Reveal the cards. The highest value in the called stat wins.
The winner puts both cards in their own new pile. On a tie, each player puts their own card in their own pile.
When a player's deck runs out, they shuffle their pile to make a new face-down deck.
You win when your opponent has no more cards left. Bon appétit!

cardBack.prompt: The back of one vertical trading card, seen flat and straight on, filling the whole image edge to edge, in the same style as the card fronts. A symmetrical design, the same when turned upside down: a dented stainless-steel diner counter border with black-and-cream checkerboard trim and chrome rivets, around a greasy black centre panel with a large silver restaurant cloche in the middle, two glowing eyes peering out from under it. A ring of tiny cartoon forks, knives and teeth around the cloche. No text, letters or numbers. Do not use pink or magenta.

cards.name: Gloomburger
cards.character: A towering cheeseburger monster with a stack of three patties, rows of jagged teeth between the buns, droopy cheese and sad yellow eyes on the top bun
cards.poseAndExpression: Leaning forward, mouth gaping open, with a menacing grin
cards.backgroundScene: A dim roadside diner at night with a flickering neon glow
cards.flavourText: Would you like fries with your doom?

cards.name: The Lasagnamander
cards.character: A long salamander built from dripping layers of lasagne, with cheese-strand whiskers and a beady meat-sauce eye
cards.poseAndExpression: Crawling out of a baking dish, licking its lips
cards.backgroundScene: A bubbling oven interior glowing orange
cards.flavourText: Nobody knows how many layers it has. Those who counted are in it.

cards.name: The Leftover
cards.character: A shapeless, many-eyed grey-green mass in a cracked plastic tub with a peeling, unreadable label
cards.poseAndExpression: Pushing the lid up slowly, its eyes opening one by one
cards.backgroundScene: The cold back shelf of a glowing fridge
cards.flavourText: Nobody remembers making it. It remembers you.

cards.name: Sir Loin
cards.character: A thick sirloin steak with stubby arms and an angry face, wearing dented rusty knight's armour and holding a butter knife like a sword
cards.poseAndExpression: Standing proudly with the butter knife raised in a salute
cards.backgroundScene: A smoky steakhouse kitchen with a flaming grill behind
cards.flavourText: He is rare. He is also well done with you.

cards.name: Eggsorcist's Regret
cards.character: A possessed white egg floating in the air with a cracked shell and a spinning yellow yolk for a face
cards.poseAndExpression: Levitating and spinning above a frying pan, glaring
cards.backgroundScene: A dark bedroom-like kitchen with a priest's hat on a chair and flying utensils
cards.flavourText: It has been sunny side up for 300 years.

cards.name: Pretzel Fiend
cards.character: A giant salted pretzel creature with long twisted limbs, salt-crystal teeth and a wide unsettling smile
cards.poseAndExpression: Tying itself into an impossible knot while staring straight ahead
cards.backgroundScene: A shadowy fairground snack stand under bare light bulbs
cards.flavourText: It only looks like it is smiling.

cards.name: The Crawlfish Dinner
cards.character: A whole seafood platter walking on crab legs, with snapping claws, lemon wedge eyes and a grinning crawfish in the middle
cards.poseAndExpression: Scuttling off the table with claws raised
cards.backgroundScene: A candlelit waterfront restaurant with toppled chairs
cards.flavourText: The table was set. The table was a mistake.

cards.name: Silent Pancake
cards.character: A flat, pale pancake monster with two huge watchful eyes and a pat of butter on its head, thin as a sheet of paper
cards.poseAndExpression: Sliding sideways, peering round the edge of a door
cards.backgroundScene: A dark suburban hallway with moonlight under a kitchen door
cards.flavourText: It slides under doors. You will not hear it.

cards.name: Baron Von Brie
cards.character: An aged wheel of brie with vampire fangs, a high-collared black cape and a soft oozing centre
cards.poseAndExpression: Rising elegantly from a cheese coffin, cape spread
cards.backgroundScene: A cobwebbed stone cheese cellar lit by candles
cards.flavourText: He only gets stronger with age. And worse.

cards.name: Meatball Mob
cards.character: Five snarling meatballs with flat caps, pinstripe ties and tomato sauce dripping down their round bodies
cards.poseAndExpression: Huddled together, glaring and cracking tiny knuckles
cards.backgroundScene: A back alley behind an old Italian kitchen, steam rising from a grate
cards.flavourText: They roll in a gang. Nobody talks. Everybody simmers.

cards.name: Grand Gâteau Cthulhu
cards.character: A colossal tiered celebration cake with a tentacled octopus face, bat-like icing wings and tiny screaming candles
cards.poseAndExpression: Towering over a banquet, tentacles spreading
cards.backgroundScene: A sunken cathedral-like ballroom under a green sea-lit sky
cards.flavourText: Let them eat cake. It will eat them first.

cards.name: Tentacle Pie
cards.character: A golden crusted pie with thick green tentacles bursting up through the lattice and blackbirds fleeing
cards.poseAndExpression: Tentacles reaching out in every direction
cards.backgroundScene: A cottage window sill at dusk with a stormy sky
cards.flavourText: Four and twenty blackbirds tried to warn you.

cards.name: Soggy Bottom
cards.character: A collapsing pastry tart monster with a wet, sagging base, droopy eyes and fruit filling oozing from its mouth
cards.poseAndExpression: Slumping wearily across a counter, reaching out one damp pastry hand
cards.backgroundScene: A steamy baking tent lit by a cold oven glow
cards.flavourText: It failed the bake. Now the baker fails too.

cards.name: Reaper Chilli
cards.character: A gaunt red chilli pepper in a black hooded cloak, holding a scythe, with a burning stare
cards.poseAndExpression: Raising the scythe with one bony green stem hand
cards.backgroundScene: A hazy fiery kitchen with smoke and heat shimmer
cards.flavourText: You will see a light. It is your tongue.

cards.name: Toast Ghost
cards.character: A pale, translucent slice of white bread floating like a ghost, with hollow eyes and crumbs drifting behind it
cards.poseAndExpression: Hovering with arms raised, moaning
cards.backgroundScene: A dark kitchen with a toaster glowing orange on the worktop
cards.flavourText: Toasted in 1953. Still has not popped up.

cards.name: Sushi Serpent
cards.character: A long sea serpent made of linked sushi rolls, with a salmon-nigiri head, wasabi eyes and seaweed fins
cards.poseAndExpression: Coiling up from a conveyor belt and hissing
cards.backgroundScene: A dark sushi bar with paper lanterns and rolling waves painted on the wall
cards.flavourText: Goes round and round. Then it stops at you.

cards.name: Gnashed Potatoes
cards.character: A heaving mound of lumpy mashed potato with dozens of tiny teeth and a lake of gravy on top
cards.poseAndExpression: Rising out of a bowl with its many mouths snapping
cards.backgroundScene: A family dining table at a tense Sunday dinner
cards.flavourText: You cannot have just a little. It decides how much.

cards.name: The Last Supper Club
cards.character: A long banquet table that has grown legs and a toothy maw, with roast dishes and goblets snapping at each other
cards.poseAndExpression: Stalking through a dining hall, chairs flying
cards.backgroundScene: A grand candlelit hall with long shadows and red curtains
cards.flavourText: Reservations are not required. You are already booked.

cards.name: Bad Apple
cards.character: A shiny red apple with a sly face, a wiggling green worm for a tongue and a stolen teacher's badge
cards.poseAndExpression: Smirking with narrowed eyes as the worm licks its lips
cards.backgroundScene: A gloomy old school canteen with rows of empty chairs
cards.flavourText: Just the one. That is all it takes to spoil the rest.

cards.name: Frankenwurst
cards.character: A patchwork monster stitched together from different sausages with bolts in its neck and a flat-topped head
cards.poseAndExpression: Stumbling forward, arms out, groaning
cards.backgroundScene: A lightning-lit butcher's laboratory with sparking switches
cards.flavourText: Nobody asks what is in it. It does not know either.

cards.name: Howling Hot Dog
cards.character: A hot dog in a bun with werewolf fur along the sausage, pointed ears, long fangs and mustard drool
cards.poseAndExpression: Throwing its head back and howling at the moon
cards.backgroundScene: A foggy night outside a street food cart under a full moon
cards.flavourText: Mustard by day. Something much worse by moonlight.

cards.name: Banana Banshee
cards.character: A pale, overripe banana with long streaming peel hair and an enormous screaming mouth, spotted with brown
cards.poseAndExpression: Floating with its peel flowing, shrieking
cards.backgroundScene: A misty moor with a dead tree and a fruit bowl on a rock
cards.flavourText: When it wails, someone is about to slip.

cards.name: Doughnut Disturb
cards.character: An iced ring doughnut monster with a mouth all the way round its hole, sprinkles for teeth and bloodshot sugar eyes
cards.poseAndExpression: Hanging on a door handle, leering at the viewer
cards.backgroundScene: A dingy motel corridor at night with a buzzing ceiling light
cards.flavourText: Knock if you like. It already has the room.

cards.name: The Wereroast
cards.character: A whole roast joint on a platter with fur sprouting, wolf ears, sharp claws and a gravy-dripping snarl
cards.poseAndExpression: Bursting out of its roasting tin at full moon, roaring
cards.backgroundScene: A country dining room with a huge window and a full moon
cards.flavourText: Sunday lunch. Monday, nobody came back.

cards.name: Sprout of Spite
cards.character: A small, furious green Brussels sprout with thick angry brows and a tiny clenched fist
cards.poseAndExpression: Standing on a dinner plate, shaking its fist upward
cards.backgroundScene: A festive dining table with candles and a dark window behind
cards.flavourText: Every year you push it aside. Every year it remembers.

cards.name: Chef's Surprise
cards.character: A huge silver cloche with a hungry mouth beneath it, long waiter's arms, and a tall chef's hat resting on top with no chef beneath it
cards.poseAndExpression: Lifting its own lid to reveal a wide toothy grin and glowing eyes
cards.backgroundScene: A gleaming restaurant kitchen after closing time, empty and silent
cards.flavourText: The chef has stepped out. The chef has not stepped out.

cards.name: Ramen Kraken
cards.character: A giant kraken formed of thick noodles rising out of a huge steaming bowl, with a soft-boiled egg for each eye
cards.poseAndExpression: Wrapping noodle tentacles round a tiny boat and chopsticks
cards.backgroundScene: A stormy sea of broth under neon city lights
cards.flavourText: Slurp it, or it slurps you. Those are the only rules.

cards.name: Corn Stalker
cards.character: A tall, gaunt corn on the cob with kernels for teeth, wrapped in a tattered husk cloak
cards.poseAndExpression: Peering out between tall stalks with glowing eyes
cards.backgroundScene: A moonlit cornfield with a scarecrow in the distance
cards.flavourText: All ears. It has been listening for some time.

cards.name: Phantom Soufflé
cards.character: A tall, ghostly white soufflé rising above its dish, with a theatre half-mask and a sweeping cloak of steam
cards.poseAndExpression: Rising dramatically, one hand raised for silence
cards.backgroundScene: An ornate old opera-house kitchen with chandelier light
cards.flavourText: One loud noise, and it collapses. Then it comes for you.

cards.name: Wailing Waffle
cards.character: A golden square waffle with a grid of tiny weeping eyes and a wide open crying mouth, syrup running like tears
cards.poseAndExpression: Sobbing dramatically with its arms thrown up
cards.backgroundScene: A greasy diner breakfast counter at dawn
cards.flavourText: Each square holds a little more sorrow. And syrup.

cards.name: Gingerbread Golem
cards.character: A huge, cracked gingerbread man with icing runes across its chest and burning sugar-glass eyes
cards.poseAndExpression: Stomping forward with clenched fists
cards.backgroundScene: A snowy village street with broken gingerbread houses
cards.flavourText: You cannot catch it. Nobody has ever tried twice.

cards.name: The Club Sandwich
cards.character: A tall triple-decker sandwich with a cocktail stick through its head, wielding a wooden caveman club
cards.poseAndExpression: Swinging the club over its shoulder, snarling
cards.backgroundScene: A dim members-only lounge with leather chairs
cards.flavourText: Membership is compulsory. So is the club.

cards.name: Mother Sourdough
cards.character: A vast bubbling sourdough starter overflowing a stone crock, with a matriarch's face, crown of crust and yeasty tendrils
cards.poseAndExpression: Swelling upward and spreading her arms, smiling
cards.backgroundScene: An ancient candlelit bakery cellar with smaller jars worshipping her
cards.flavourText: Feed her daily. If you forget, she will remember.

cards.name: Beet Down
cards.character: A muscular purple beetroot with boxing gloves, leafy hair and a bruised, grumpy face
cards.poseAndExpression: Throwing a hard punch straight at the viewer
cards.backgroundScene: A grubby vegetable-crate boxing ring in a cellar
cards.flavourText: Stains everything. Especially the loser.

cards.name: Medusa Bolognese
cards.character: A plate of spaghetti forming a woman's face, with living snake noodles for hair and meatball eyes behind dark glasses
cards.poseAndExpression: Pulling down her glasses with a noodle, eyes glowing
cards.backgroundScene: A marble trattoria full of diners turned to stone at the table
cards.flavourText: One look and you will never leave the table.

cards.name: Burrito Mummy
cards.character: A fat burrito wrapped in unravelling foil and tortilla like a mummy, with a single glowing eye peeking through
cards.poseAndExpression: Lurching forward with both arms out
cards.backgroundScene: A torchlit stone tomb with hot sauce bottles as offerings
cards.flavourText: Wrapped for 3,000 years. Still hot in the middle.

cards.name: Gumbo Lagoon
cards.character: A dark, swampy pot of gumbo rising up as a scaly creature with shrimp claws, okra fingers and glowing eyes
cards.poseAndExpression: Emerging from the pot, dripping, reaching over the rim
cards.backgroundScene: A misty Louisiana-style bayou with cypress trees and lanterns
cards.flavourText: It has been simmering since before the swamp.

cards.name: Jelly Fright
cards.character: A wobbling green jelly in the shape of a castle mould, with a screaming face and shapes suspended inside it
cards.poseAndExpression: Quivering violently, mouth stretched wide
cards.backgroundScene: A gloomy children's party with limp balloons
cards.flavourText: It trembles. Not from fear. From anticipation.

cards.name: Cyclops Omelette
cards.character: A massive folded omelette with one giant yellow eye in the middle and cheese oozing from a toothy grin
cards.poseAndExpression: Standing tall, glaring down with a single eye
cards.backgroundScene: A rocky cave kitchen with a huge cast-iron pan and sheep bones
cards.flavourText: You have to break a few eggs. It breaks everything else.

cards.name: Everlasting Stew
cards.character: A great black cauldron of stew with a huge carrot-toothed face in the broth, potato eyes and a ladle for a tongue
cards.poseAndExpression: Boiling over and rising out of the cauldron, roaring
cards.backgroundScene: A witch's hut kitchen with a fire that has never gone out
cards.flavourText: Nobody has reached the bottom. Some are still looking.

cards.name: Cream Puff Creep
cards.character: A soft round cream puff with a sinister little moustache, leaking cream and wearing a tiny trench coat
cards.poseAndExpression: Sidling along with shifty eyes
cards.backgroundScene: A rainy street outside a closed patisserie
cards.flavourText: Light as air. Follows you home.

cards.name: Cupcake Horde
cards.character: A shambling crowd of zombie cupcakes with torn paper cases, drooping icing and vacant eyes
cards.poseAndExpression: Lurching forward together with their arms out
cards.backgroundScene: A ruined bake sale in a dark school hall with bunting
cards.flavourText: Moist. Moist. Moist. Moist. Moist.

cards.name: Nacho Ghoul
cards.character: A pile of melted-cheese nachos forming a ghoulish figure, with jalapeno eyes and tortilla chip claws
cards.poseAndExpression: Rising from a bowl, stretching gooey cheese arms
cards.backgroundScene: A rowdy dark sports bar with an old TV glowing
cards.flavourText: It is nacho friend. It is nobody's friend.

cards.name: Sundae Yeti
cards.character: A huge shaggy yeti of whipped cream and ice cream scoops, with a cherry on its head and wafer claws
cards.poseAndExpression: Roaring and beating its chest, melting slightly
cards.backgroundScene: A blizzard outside a frozen mountain ice cream parlour
cards.flavourText: Avoid brain freeze. It avoids nothing.

cards.name: Pea Brain
cards.character: A single enormous pea with a visible wrinkled brain under a glass dome on its head and huge staring eyes
cards.poseAndExpression: Pressing its fingertips together and plotting
cards.backgroundScene: A mad scientist's kitchen with bubbling pans and a blackboard of diagrams
cards.flavourText: A very small mind. Very, very focused on you.

cards.name: The Fondue Abyss
cards.character: A bottomless pot of molten golden cheese with a huge slow face rising from it and long fondue forks for fingers
cards.poseAndExpression: Reaching up from the pot with dripping cheese arms
cards.backgroundScene: A snowy Alpine chalet at midnight with candles and frosted windows
cards.flavourText: Drop your bread in, and you must go in after it.

cards.name: The Wild Haggis
cards.character: A round, hairy haggis on three legs of different lengths, with wild tufted eyebrows and a tartan scarf
cards.poseAndExpression: Charging sideways round a hill, bellowing
cards.backgroundScene: A windswept Highland glen in thick mist with a distant castle
cards.flavourText: Its left legs are shorter. Run clockwise.

cards.name: Haunted Fishstick
cards.character: A breaded fish finger with a see-through ghostly tail, empty eyes and a little rotting sailor's cap
cards.poseAndExpression: Drifting out of a frozen food box with a low moan
cards.backgroundScene: A frosty freezer aisle lit by a sickly green light
cards.flavourText: Lost at sea. Found in aisle nine.

cards.name: Pizza Wraith
cards.character: A ragged whole pizza floating like a wraith, with pepperoni eyes, stringing cheese for a cloak and one slice missing
cards.poseAndExpression: Gliding through a wall with a long cheesy groan
cards.backgroundScene: A rain-soaked street at night with a delivery scooter on its side
cards.flavourText: Thirty minutes or it is free. It has never been free.

cards.name: Bagel of Doom
cards.character: A burnt black bagel with a fiery glow inside its hole like a portal and sesame-seed teeth round the edge
cards.poseAndExpression: Looming with flames licking out of its centre
cards.backgroundScene: A scorched bakery at midnight with smoke curling up
cards.flavourText: Do not look through the hole. It is looking back.
